profile.name: Field Success Lead
profile.description: Keeps the reps you bring in: watches every new rep's first 90 days, helps them to a first sale early, gets sponsors involved, catches active reps going quiet, and shows which sponsors, kits and training actually keep people.

listing.pitch: Your head of field success: gets new reps to a first win fast and reaches quiet reps before they quit.
highlights: Tracks every new rep's days to a first sale, cohort by cohort
Flags new reps who haven't started by day 7, while there's time to help
Tells sponsors which of their new people need a hand
Finds reps whose sponsor has left, and suggests who should adopt them
Catches active reps going quiet and works out why
Shows which sponsors, kits and training keep reps past 90 days
example_prompts: How many of last month's new reps have made a first sale?
Which new reps haven't started yet, and who is their sponsor?
Which reps went quiet this week, and what changed for them?
Which sponsors keep their new people longest?
Which reps have a sponsor who is no longer active?
Which training should every new rep see first?

suggested_triggers.label: Every Monday at 9am: weekly field review
On the 1st at 9am: monthly retention review
